description_en: Queries abnormal cloud resources added in cloud native mode
description_zh: 查询异常的云产品接入资源
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-abnormal-cloud-resources --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAbnormalCloudResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of your WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: a region outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
